title: Equations and Inequalities
preview: Use substitution to test solutions, solve one-step equations, and write one-step inequalities to model constraints.
description: Indiana standards 6.AF.2–4. Students solve one-step equations across the four operations and represent constraints with one-step inequalities.

sections.label: 6-1 Use Substitution to Solve One-Step Equations
sections.description: Determine whether a given value makes an equation or inequality true.

sections.label: 6-2 One-Step Addition Equations
sections.description: Solve equations of the form x + p = q for nonnegative rationals.

sections.label: 6-3 One-Step Subtraction Equations
sections.description: Solve equations of the form x − p = q for nonnegative rationals.

sections.label: 6-4 One-Step Multiplication Equations
sections.description: Solve equations of the form px = q for nonnegative rationals.

sections.label: 6-5 One-Step Division Equations
sections.description: Solve equations of the form x/p = q for nonnegative rationals.

sections.label: 6-6 Inequalities
sections.description: Write one-step inequalities to represent constraints; graph the solution set on a number line.
